Access parsed IMU data stored in a move2

Source: R/imu_col_attr.R
mt_imu.Rd

Return the values contained in the currently designated column storing data for the indicated sensor.

To set a column that contains data from a given sensor, use the corresponding setting function. For instance, mt_set_acc_column().

Usage

mt_acc(x)

mt_mag(x)

mt_gyro(x)

Arguments

x

A move2 object with an IMU vector column (for instance, produced by as_acc(), as_mag(), or as_gyro()).

Value

An object inheriting from class imu containing the data in the indicated column of x.

Details

The data contained in the designated IMU column for the given sensor must be in the corresponding class. For instance, the acc_column set by mt_set_acc_column() must contain an acc vector. mt_acc() validates the data class before returning.

The designated column can be lost or become out of date when the data are modified. See the "Current limitations" section of mt_acc_column().

See also

mt_acc_column(), mt_mag_column(), mt_gyro_column() to get or set the column that contains parsed data for a given sensor.

Examples

alb <- albatrosses()
alb$acc <- as_acc(alb)
alb <- mt_set_acc_column(alb, "acc")

mt_acc(alb)
